units.source_text: 脱下来的这些衣物，给人一种"荣誉坟墓"似的印象，

en.t: These discarded articles of clothing gave the impression of something like a "grave of honor,"

units.source_text: 5月的花团簇锦，更加强了这种感觉。

en.t: and the luxuriant clusters of May flowers strengthened that feeling even more.

units.source_text: 特别是帽舌上反射着漆黑闪光的制帽，以及挂在它旁边的皮带和短剑，

en.t: In particular, the military cap whose brim reflected a jet-black gleam, together with the belt and short sword hanging beside it,

units.source_text: 脱离了他的肉体，反而荡出一种抒情的美，

en.t: separated from his body, instead gave off a kind of lyrical beauty,

units.source_text: 其本身如同回忆一般完整……就是说，看似是年轻英雄的遗物。

en.t: complete in themselves like memories... in other words, they seemed to be the relics of a young hero.
